# Intents

An intent is one outward act, written as a file in the outbox. A lane writes it with `cockpit outbox new <ticket> <type> --card <card> --summary <text>` and the payload options below; nothing happens until it is endorsed and published.

## Types

| Type | Required | Optional | At least one of | Example payload |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `push-branch` | `--repo`, `--branch` | `--publish-as`, `--sha`, `--base`, `--rebase-only`, `--after`, `--waits-for` |  | `--repo api --branch work/TASK-1` |
| `open-pr` | `--repo`, `--title` | `--branch`, `--publish-as`, `--head`, `--base`, `--body`, `--body-file`, `--labels`, `--related`, `--after`, `--ready`, `--sha`, `--waits-for` | `--branch`, `--head`, `--publish-as` | `--repo api --branch work/TASK-1 --title 'TASK-1: export' --body-file pr.md --labels 'needs review'` |
| `pr-edit` | `--repo`, `--number` | `--base`, `--title`, `--title-append`, `--body`, `--body-file`, `--labels`, `--add-labels`, `--remove-labels`, `--assignee`, `--after`, `--sha`, `--ready`, `--issue-from`, `--waits-for` | `--base`, `--title`, `--title-append`, `--body`, `--body-file`, `--labels`, `--add-labels`, `--remove-labels`, `--assignee`, `--ready` | `--repo api --number 12 --add-labels ready` |
| `pr-patch-apply` | `--repo`, `--number`, `--branch`, `--threads-file` | `--publish-as`, `--sha`, `--base`, `--waits-for` |  | `--repo api --number 12 --branch work/TASK-1 --threads-file plan.json` |
| `pr-comment` | `--repo`, `--number` | `--body`, `--body-file`, `--in-reply-to`, `--thread`, `--react`, `--resolve`, `--after`, `--sha`, `--waits-for` |  | `--repo api --number 12 --in-reply-to 4001 --thread PRRT_1 --body-file reply.md --resolve` |
| `pr-review-submit` | `--repo`, `--number`, `--sha` | `--event`, `--body`, `--body-file`, `--threads-file`, `--review-id`, `--patch-comments`, `--review-body-update`, `--after`, `--waits-for` |  | `--repo api --number 12 --sha <reviewed head> --threads-file review.json --body-file summary.md` |
| `tracker-comment` |  | `--issue`, `--body`, `--body-file`, `--comment-id`, `--comment-from`, `--probe-title`, `--attach`, `--run`, `--waits-for` | `--body`, `--body-file` | `--issue TASK-1 --body-file run.md --attach evidence/row-1.mp4` |
| `tracker-create` | `--summary` | `--project`, `--issue-type`, `--body`, `--body-file`, `--labels`, `--component`, `--sprint`, `--assignee`, `--transition`, `--waits-for` |  | `--summary 'Bump the parser' --labels deps --transition 'In Progress'` |
| `tracker-transition` | `--to` | `--issue`, `--issue-from`, `--assignee`, `--after`, `--waits-for` |  | `--issue TASK-1 --to 'In Review'` |
| `infra-note` |  | `--repo`, `--body`, `--body-file`, `--branch`, `--patch-file`, `--number`, `--waits-for` |  | `--body-file note.md` |
| `ci-rerun` | `--repo`, `--run-id` | `--workflow`, `--sha`, `--waits-for` |  | `--repo api --run-id 42` |
| `ticket-done` |  | `--repo`, `--number`, `--merged-at`, `--url`, `--numbers`, `--waits-for` |  |  |

Never published by cockpit (the human acts and acknowledges): `infra-note`, `ticket-done`. Pushes (a verify command runs on their range): `push-branch`, `pr-patch-apply`.

## Statuses

Open: `pending`, `endorsed`, `held`, `returned`, `posted`. Published: `published`, `published-manually`.

| From | May move to |
|---|---|
| `pending` | `acknowledged`, `dropped`, `endorsed`, `held`, `pending`, `published-manually`, `reopened`, `returned` |
| `endorsed` | `dropped`, `held`, `pending`, `posted`, `published`, `published-manually`, `returned` |
| `held` | `dropped`, `endorsed`, `held`, `pending`, `returned` |
| `returned` | `dropped`, `endorsed`, `pending`, `returned` |
| `posted` | `endorsed`, `published` |
| `published` | `endorsed`, `pending` |
| `published-manually` | `endorsed`, `pending` |
| `acknowledged` | `reopened` |
| `reopened` | (nothing) |
| `dropped` | `pending` |
